skills.name: Punctuation (commas, semicolons, colons, dashes, apostrophes)
skills.tip: Decide what is on each side of the mark before you pick the mark.

skills.name: Grammar and usage (agreement, pronouns, verb tense, modifiers)
skills.tip: Cross out everything between the subject and the verb.

skills.name: Sentence structure (fragments, run-ons, parallelism)
skills.tip: Every sentence needs one subject-verb pair that can stand alone.

skills.name: Topic development and relevance (add, delete, purpose)
skills.tip: Would the paragraph lose anything if this sentence vanished? That answers add/delete.

skills.name: Organization, unity, transitions
skills.tip: Read the sentence before and after; the transition must fit both.

skills.name: Word choice, tone, concision
skills.tip: Shortest choice that keeps the meaning usually wins.

skills.name: Number, operations, ratios, percents
skills.tip: Write the units; let them cancel.

skills.name: Linear equations, inequalities, systems
skills.tip: Isolate in two moves max.

skills.name: Functions, quadratics, exponentials
skills.tip: Vertex form for max/min, factored form for roots.

skills.name: Plane geometry: angles, triangles, circles, area
skills.tip: No formula sheet on the ACT. Know area, circumference, Pythagorean theorem cold.

skills.name: Coordinate geometry: slope, distance, midpoint, conics basics
skills.tip: Slope first; most coordinate questions are slope in disguise.

skills.name: Trigonometry: SOH CAH TOA, unit circle, identities
skills.tip: Draw the triangle. Label the sides. Then the ratio.

skills.name: Statistics, probability, counting
skills.tip: Probability is favorable over total; counting is multiply the slots.

skills.name: Modeling and multi-step word problems
skills.tip: Translate the sentence to an equation before you compute anything.

skills.name: Key ideas and details (locate, paraphrase)
skills.tip: Go back to the line. Never answer from memory.

skills.name: Inference and author's view
skills.tip: The right inference is the smallest step from the text.

skills.name: Craft and structure (word meaning, purpose, tone)
skills.tip: Ask what the sentence does, not what it says.

skills.name: Integration of knowledge (paired passages, argument)
skills.tip: Pin each author's position in five words before the choices.

skills.name: Data representation (reading tables and graphs)
skills.tip: Find the axis labels and units before the numbers.

skills.name: Research summaries (experiment design, variables, controls)
skills.tip: Name the independent, dependent and controlled variables in the margin.

skills.name: Conflicting viewpoints
skills.tip: One sentence per scientist: what they claim and the one fact they lean on.
